seo.title: Greek objective property value calculator
seo.description: Free indicative calculation of the objective (tax) value of a home, storage room or parking space in Greece: the zone price from the map position and the coefficients of POL.1149/1994, explained step by step.

page.title: Objective value calculator
page.intro: Find the zone price from the property's position and calculate the objective value with the statutory coefficients. We only ask what affects your property.
page.scope: Covers homes and apartments (including multi-level), storage rooms and parking spaces within town plans. It does not cover business premises, plots, special buildings or properties outside town plans.

commercialityFactor.help: Listed next to the zone price in the Ministry's tables. On this floor it changes the floor coefficient.

result.title: 4. Result
result.label: Objective value (indicative)
result.disclaimer: Indicative calculation. The taxable value is finalised in AADE's myPROPERTY. This is not a market value estimate.

problems.nonPositiveZonePrice: The zone price must be positive.
problems.commercialityBelowOne: The commerciality coefficient cannot be below 1.
problems.negativeAge: The permit date is not valid.
problems.ownershipShareOutOfRange: The ownership share must be above 0 and up to 100%.
problems.foundationStageAboveGround: The “foundations” stage applies only to a basement or ground floor.

unsupported.type: The calculation currently covers homes and storage rooms.

whatIs.a: It is the value set by the objective valuation system (POL.1149/1994): zone price × area × coefficients for floor, age, frontage and more. It is the tax base for transfers and the ENFIA property tax. It is not the market value.

zonePrice.q: Where do I find the zone price?
zonePrice.a: The calculator finds it from the property's position, using the Ministry's open zone data. If the property fronts a street with its own frontage price, that one applies.

commerciality.a: It is a per-zone coefficient that changes the floor coefficient from the ground floor up to the 3rd floor. It has no effect for basements or from the 4th floor up, so we don't ask for it there.

age.a: From the date of issue or last revision of the building permit. The first two years don't count, and a remainder under six months is ignored.

binding.a: No. It is an indicative calculation from the details you enter. The taxable value is finalised in AADE's myPROPERTY.
